entry.title: v9.0.22: Merged PR 67358: [9.0-hotfix] Update Brotli to 1.1.1
entry.content:
AI description (iteration 1)

PR Classification

Security fix: upgrades the vendored Brotli library to 1.1.1 to address CVE-2026-111497, an out-of-bounds write vulnerability that could permit remote code execution.

PR Summary

This PR updates the bundled Brotli dependency from 1.1.0 to 1.1.1, incorporating a decoder fix for a security vulnerability along with improved error handling in block type/length decoding.

  • dec/decode.c: Refactors block switch decoding functions to return BrotliDecoderErrorCode instead of BROTLI_BOOL, enabling more precise error propagation (e.g., distinguishing NEEDS_MORE_INPUT from format errors), and adds a new BROTLI_SAFE_WITH_STATUS macro.
  • include/brotli/decode.h: Adds new error code BROTLI_DECODER_ERROR_FORMAT_BLOCK_SWITCH (previously reserved as -17).
  • common/version.h and brotli-version.txt: Bump version to 1.1.1 and ABI revision to 1.
  • cgmanifest.json: Updates commit hash reference to match the new Brotli version.
  • Adds CHANGELOG.md and .bazelignore as new files from the upstream Brotli repository.

entry.title: v8.0.33: Merged PR 67357: [8.0-hotfix] Update Brotli to 1.0.10
entry.content:
AI description (iteration 1)

PR Classification

Dependency update/bug fix: upgrades the vendored Brotli library to version 1.0.10 to incorporate upstream decoder fixes.

PR Summary

This PR updates the bundled Brotli native dependency from 1.0.9 to 1.0.10, primarily fixing decoder error handling for block switch operations.

  • dec/decode.c: Refactored block switch decoding functions (DecodeLiteralBlockSwitch, DecodeCommandBlockSwitch, DecodeDistanceBlockSwitch, and DecodeBlockTypeAndLength) to return BrotliDecoderErrorCode instead of BROTLI_BOOL, adding a new BROTLI_SAFE_WITH_STATUS macro for improved error propagation.
  • include/brotli/decode.h: Added new error code BLOCK_SWITCH (-17) to the error code enumeration.
  • common/version.h: Bumped BROTLI_VERSION and BROTLI_ABI_VERSION to reflect the 1.0.10 release.
  • cgmanifest.json and brotli-version.txt: Updated commit hash and version metadata to 1.0.10.

entry.title: v11.0.0-rc.3.26522.148: [release/11.0-rc2] Managed HPKE (#134443)
entry.content:
cherry-pick of 2023ab7 (#133804)

Customer Impact

  • Customer reported
  • Found internally

New API for .NET 11 to support using HPKE as part of the PQC transition
effort.

Regression

  • Yes
  • No

Testing

This standalone feature is extensively tested in this PR.

Risk

Low. The feature is entirely isolated, only consumers of these new
[Experimental] types are affected.

This change contains the full API set for the feature, but does not
represent full functionality (e.g. Win32 interop instead of the managed
implementation on Windows), which can be added in servicing.
